title: Vintage OOP Meet Prince Charming VHS Rare 1999 Tia Carrere SEALED Blockbuster
descriptionText: The product is a rare and vintage VHS tape of the 1999 romantic drama film "Meet Prince Charming" starring Tia Carrere. This out-of-print (OOP) tape is sealed and from a former Blockbuster rental, making it highly collectible. Directed by Brett Parker and featuring David Charvet, this NTSC formatted VHS offers a unique viewing experience of this English language film that was released in the United States in 1999. Perfect for fans of vintage movies and collectors of OOP VHS tapes.
